verdicts.reason: Both break up the text column the same way: the eyebrow floats about 70px above the headline, there is a large dead gap between the headline, the body copy and the RSVP button, and in both the headphone illustration has come apart, with the headband and cups sitting above the dark circle instead of inside it. A is worse: the date card is oversized and jammed 22px from the left edge, and the circle almost touches the bottom edge, so it looks cramped and cropped. B keeps the date card in proportion with better margins and a more contained circle, but it still has the scattered spacing and the broken graphic.
